_comment: Backbones are downloaded from the Hugging Face Hub at run time; no weights are stored in this repository. Set MEDLM_MODEL_CACHE to control where they are cached.
verifier_note: The verifier is a sequence-classification head fine-tuned on question-answer pairs. Train it with scripts/pipeline/train_verifier.py, then point MEDLM_VERIFIER or --verifier at the result.
